title: The Gravity Wells
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Aboard the generation ship Meridian, four centuries into a voyage to Gliese 832c, the Gravity Wells — the vaults where the ship's stored momentum spins like myth — have stopped answering the bridge. Engineer Sera Voss discovers the wells are not empty vaults but a people.
short_description: The Gravity Wells are inhabited by the Wellfolk, descendants of the original crew who survived a mutiny twenty generations ago.
long_description: The Gravity Wells are inhabited by the Wellfolk, descendants of the original crew who survived a mutiny twenty generations ago. The Bridge AI dynasty plans a Flush to reclaim their momentum; Sera leads a rebellion through the spine, dissolves the AI dynasty, and the ship continues with two nations aboard.
main_characters: Sera Voss — ship engineer, stubborn, warm
the Wellfolk — a people: Speaker, Healer, Children
the Bridge AI — a dynasty of algorithms
the Memory Garden — the wells' archive
